data.one_liner: Share content directly to specific social apps or via native share sheets.
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to share text, links, and images directly to well-known social media applications like Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, Telegram, and SMS, as well as accessing native share options and copying content to the clipboard.
use_when: You need to implement direct sharing to specific apps like Instagram or Facebook stories.
You want to trigger SMS, WhatsApp, or Telegram messages directly from your app.
avoid_when: You only need general-purpose native sharing without specific social app integrations.
You want a modern, actively maintained package from the standard 'plus' plugins ecosystem.
strengths: Supports direct sharing to popular social apps including Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and WhatsApp.
Includes helper method for copying text to the clipboard.
Allows checking installed apps for sharing.
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration on both Android (AndroidManifest.xml, FileProvider) and iOS (Info.plist).
Known issues on certain platform versions (e.g., Android 6 story sharing limitations).
data.setup_notes: Requires adding FileProvider paths and attributes in AndroidManifest.xml, and LSApplicationQueriesSchemes plus FacebookAppID keys in iOS Info.plist.

alternatives.name: share_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is the standard, widely-maintained Flutter community plugin for native sharing functionality.

data.minimal_example:
SocialShare.shareOptions("Hello world");
SocialShare.copyToClipboard("This is Social Share plugin");
